QuestInfo.name: Agility Enhancement Course
QuestInfo.0: Participate in the Resistance's educational program. Talk to #b#p2151010##k at the Underground Base #m310010010#.
QuestInfo.1: There are a total of three courses in this educational program. The first course focuses on enhancing your agility. Enter #m310010100# and eliminate  #r#o9300409##k. #o9300409# has the ability to become transparent, so you must be careful.\r\n\r\n#o9300409##r #a231031##k
QuestInfo.2: You completed the Agility Training Course and reported back to #p2151010#.

0.0: Ah! Our newest recruit. I will be your instructor for the Resistance's Educational Program, a series of challenges designed to prepare you for your service as member of the Resistance. The program consists of three stages, each designed to strengthen you in an area vital to your duties. Upon completion, you should be Level 14. That is, if you finish...
0.1: So you'll participate? Exquisite. Your first challenge focuses on honing your agility. It is a fundamental skill for all Resistance members.

yes.0: Your first exercise is quite simple. All you must do is enter #b#m310010100##k and eliminate #r15 #o9300409##k units.
yes.1: There is one minor complication... The #o9300409# model is a test of our new stealth technology, which means they can vanish in a flash. As a consequence, you will have to time your attacks to strike them while they're visible. Well then, don't lollygag. Go dispatch those robots!

no.0: Surely you'll reconsider. Going out on a mission unprepared puts our whole organization at risk!

1.0: You defeated the #o9300409# units? Good, good! Knowing when to strike is key to being an efficacious Resistance agent. Now! Ready for the next challenge?

mob.0: You haven't eliminated #r15 #o9300409# units#k yet? How disheartening. Are you sure you're willing to dedicate yourself to our cause?
